content.short: NodesHunter offers an affordable way for individuals to invest in different Nodes, by Minting a CNFT.
content.description:
NodesHunter offers an affordable way for individuals to invest in different nodes. Instead of requiring a significant financial investment, users can now purchase a percentage of a Node. Our goal is to implement scaling solutions, such as off-chain transactions and sharing, to increase the number of transactions that can be processed per second, that represent a stake in a node, we handle the Hosting, Security and distribute Rewards.

We believe in providing accurate and realistic information to our investors, rather than making lofty and unrealistic projections. All of our return percentages are based on the number of CNFT-s held, not the dollar value of the asset.
